_note: Every Teams message to Sitamah (sitamah-messaging.md) as data. Two tiers: 'action' messages open with 'Action needed:' and a one-clause summary; the one 'fyi' message carries no tag and ends 'Nothing needed from you.' Slots in {braces}; {@name} expands a list into bullets. {client} is the client's full name.

email_sent_watch.label: An email was actually sent that needs a reply watched for
email_sent_watch.summary: keep an eye out for a reply from {recipient}.
body: Just sent an email on {client}'s behalf: {subject}.
- Please watch for {recipient}'s reply
- If nothing has come back after a few business days, please follow up with the client directly

outstanding_still.label: The outstanding-request check still has items with no reply
body: Still waiting on:
{@outstanding}
Please follow up with each contact named above directly.
I check again {cadence}.

lizelle_attach.label: The Lizelle / BrightRock quote request needs the Fact Find Summary attached
lizelle_attach.summary: a draft's ready except for one attachment.
body: I've saved a draft to Lizelle for {client}, subject: {draft_subject}.
Please:
1. Open that draft in Outlook Drafts
2. Attach the client's Fact Find Summary PDF from {folder}
3. Send it
4. Follow up with Lizelle for the quotes back

loa_sent.label: The LOA explanatory email has been sent
body: I've just sent {client} the LOA explanatory email.
Please prepare the MSIGN signing pack from the LOA and Disclosure documents I pre-populated in {folder}, and send it to the client via MSIGN.

locked_file.label: A password-protected policy schedule was found on file
body: {file} in {folder} is password-protected and I can't open it.
Please re-save it without password protection so I can check it. (Nothing is needed from the client.)

general_email_drafted.label: General's consolidated client document-request email is drafted
general_email_drafted.summary: a document-request email for you to check and send.
body: I've drafted the document-request email for {client}, subject: {draft_subject}, and saved it in Outlook Drafts.
Please:
1. Check it
2. Send it if it is correct
3. Follow up with the client periodically before the next appointment

astute_loa_signed.label: The signed LOA is back and saved: Sitamah draws the Astute report
body: The signed LOA is back and saved to {folder}.
Please draw the Astute report.

coc_invite_sent.label: The COC invite has been sent
body: The 30-minute COC appointment invite is sent for {when}.
Please watch for the client's acceptance.

coc_day.label: The day of the COC appointment
body: {client}'s COC appointment is today at {when}.
Please call the client as a reminder.

coc_hour_after.label: One hour after the COC appointment's scheduled time
body: The COC appointment was scheduled for {when}.
Please confirm whether it actually happened. I will not ask for the tele-underwriting transcript until you do.

rar_drafted.label: A replacement RAR request is drafted
rar_drafted.summary: an RAR request to check, attach and send.
body: An RAR is required for {client}'s {product}, and the email is drafted in Outlook Drafts, subject: {draft_subject}.
Please:
1. Check it
2. Attach the policy schedule(s) of the policy being replaced
3. Send it
4. Watch for the completed RAR to come back

followup_moved.label: The follow-up appointment check-in came back moved or not accepted
body: {detail}
You may need to re-prep the documents or chase the client.
